a.title: Health sector monitoring and auditing: Ensure accountable use of health funds through auditability, oversight reporting and appropriate public disclosure (Goal)

text.tspan: Health sector monitoring and auditing: Ensure accountable
use of health funds through auditability, oversight

a.title: Immutable audit trails for financial events (Outcome)
Regulatory and audit reports delivered on schedule (Outcome)
Faster anomaly detection supported by monitoring outputs (Outcome)
Auditability & non-repudiation (ability to trace financial events end-to-end) (Capability)
Compliance monitoring & regulatory reporting (ability to produce mandated reports on schedule) (Capability)
Open reporting & disclosure (ability to publish appropriate public views) (Capability)
Event signing and trusted timestamping (Application Service)
WORM/ append only audit log repository (Application Component)
PKI / CA + digital signature & timestamping service (Application Component)

g.text: Colour: which part of the architecture a box belongs to
Why: who cares (stakeholders), and the drivers, goals, outcomes, values and requirements
Strategy: what the organisation is able to do (capabilities) and with what (resources, value streams)
Software: systems and their parts, the services they offer, and the data they hold
Shape: what kind of thing a box is (its small italic label names the exact kind)
Cut corners: a reason or aim, such as a stakeholder, goal, outcome or value
Rounded corners: something done or an ability, such as a capability, process or function
Rounded ends: a service, offered for others to use
Square corners: something that exists, such as a system, a role, or a piece of data
A box inside another box: a part of it
Band with a dark header: a grouping for layout only; it adds no meaning (tinted in the layer most of its boxes belong to)
Line: how two boxes are related, read from where the line starts to where it ends
